question: Why does the phase-6 SLO cohort carry scope evidence_half_through_decisions rather than end_to_end_delivery?
answer: The certifying scope is NOT PRODUCIBLE at HEAD. A cohort was not narrowed for convenience; the delivered path refuses before a workbook exists, for two independent reasons already on the register.

probes.probe: run the real controller through the full path on the acquisition fixture, with a complete Python toolchain and LibreOffice present

toolchain.python: venv built from the codex runtime python3.12 with openpyxl, pymupdf, jsonschema, numpy and Pillow importable

probes.observed_message: Portable semantic gates N0-N9 did not pass.
probes.reading: Stage 4 stops at its FIRST checkpoint. Gate N8 fails on the acquisition test fixture, so no plan, no emit, no recalculation and no validation span is ever measured. test-fixtures/** is out of scope for this package.

probes.probe: the same question asked one layer down, on a compiled production case
probes.recorded_finding: node scripts/build_dynamic_model.mjs <compiled production case> --plan-only REFUSES at build_dynamic_model.mjs:784 with 'Provenance marking contradicts the authority governing the cell', localised by git log -S refuseContradictedProvenance to bd1b973 (P5.3). No workbook can be built at HEAD.
probes.reading: Even with a production case the delivered path does not complete at HEAD, so an end_to_end_delivery cohort is unobtainable on this commit for a reason that belongs to another package.

consequence: The cohort report declares slo_coverage LOWER_BOUND_ONLY. Its percentiles are a strict subset of the end-to-end path, so they can REFUTE the 15/20/25 objective but can never certify it. Recording that in the report is the difference between evidence and a claim.
owed: An end_to_end_delivery cohort, re-run with this same harness once the workbook build is producible again. scripts/lib/runtime_slo.mjs already accepts that scope and will flip the report to CERTIFYING without any code change.
